protocol.pair_variance: sample_variance(A-B)/2; per-ROI mean drift recorded separately
protocol.split: Alternating distinct exposure levels sorted numerically within ISO; no post-score split change.
protocol.fit: Nonnegative shot slope, pooled dark1/200intercept; experimental, never published as camera calibration
protocol.reserve: Only protocole/blacks and protocole/iso-*; rafale and neural-validation unopened
